changelog: v0.8.0: 1) Expressive Full-Body Avatar Gestures & Locomotion: rich kinematics including wave, dance, stand on one leg balance, celebratory hands up, bow, think, clap, laugh, jump, and locomotion (walk, run, jump, step, left, right, forward, backward); 2) Dual Direct & Agentic Control: direct control via Meta Quest 3 controller thumbsticks and In-VR 3D HUD console, alongside Android/mobile touch floating action toolbar and desktop keyboard shortcuts; 3) Agentic Movement Tools: registered avatar_gesture, avatar_move, and avatar_freestyle tools in agentic tool registry for autonomous AI decision-making; 4) Autonomous Freestyle Mode: allows the avatar to explore the scene, wander around, jump, and spontaneously gesture organically.
